mapper.sql: id, payment_no, order_id, order_no, user_id, amount, gateway, status, success_message, success_color, env_flag, idempotent_key, paid_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_payment_order WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM t_payment_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM t_payment_order WHERE idempotent_key = #{idempotentKey} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_payment_order (payment_no, order_id, order_no, user_id, amount, gateway, status, env_flag, idempotent_key, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{paymentNo}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{gateway}, #{status}, #{envFlag}, #{idempotentKey}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_payment_order SET status = #{status}, success_message = #{message}, success_color = #{color}, paid_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
